description: AI Engineering Factory IDE — runnable prototype skeleton
name: ai-factory

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-factory/core && npm run build -w @ai-factory/db && npm run build -w @ai-factory/git && npm run build -w @ai-factory/qa && npm run build -w @ai-factory/approvals && npm run build -w @ai-factory/server && npm run build -w @ai-factory/desktop
scripts.electron: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron apps/desktop/dist-electron/main.js
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ai-factory/core && npm run build -w @ai-factory/git && npm run build -w @ai-factory/qa && npm run build -w @ai-factory/approvals && node --test packages/core/dist/tests/*.test.js packages/git/dist/tests/*.test.js packages/qa/dist/tests/*.test.js packages/approvals/dist/tests/*.test.js
